about: Real photos of a home, written down by hand: what is really in each one, and what Tote said when it was scanned. The photos themselves stay out of the repo. 'readable' things are ones a person can name from the photo; 'fair to miss' ones are hidden or unlabelled. 'confirm' marks what Sushmitha has not yet confirmed.

readable.thing: Whole milk, one gallon jug (bowl & basket)
bowl & basket tub: yogurt or sour cream
Trader Joe's bag on the top shelf
Clear bag of seeds on the top shelf

fair_to_miss: small jar with a gingham lid
small boxes on the left shelf
